sn12.59:4.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave mahārukkho || Atha puriso āgaccheyya kuddālapiṭakam ādāya || pe|| || āyatiṃ anuppādadhammo || || Evam eva kho bhikkhave saññojaniyesu dhammesu ādīnavānupassino viharato viññāṇassa avakkanti na hoti || viññāṇassa nirodhā nāmarūpanirodho || pe|| || Evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa nirodho hotīti || || Navamaṃ || ||
